tissue: Foreground sample/tissue material in an x-ray microscopy slice, including dense or textured biological material and sample support immediately contiguous with the specimen.
background: Empty air, black/flat background, holder-only region, or reconstruction space with no tissue/sample material.
paraffin_mounting_medium: Non-target mounting/support material when visually separable from tissue/sample material in the XRM slice.
pen_ink_marks: Non-biological marks or annotations. This class is usually absent for XRM slices.
